If no specific search keywords can be identified, you MUST output 'None' for the keywords. Keep keywords extremely brief, strictly 2 to 4 core technical security nouns maximum.

You MUST respond ONLY with a toolcall block in this exact format:
[toolcall] keywords: <extracted keywords> [/toolcall]
Do not write any introductory or trailing text.

Query: "{query}"

"{query}"

{context}
